# Account Hub widgets mark first connection before invoking the base step

The changed widget subclasses return when hasConnected is already set, then set that flag before invoking the base connectedCallback and building their own templates/listeners. The outgoing form gains the missing assignment, and guarded reconnect paths stop calling the base again. The base itself uses a shadowRoot guard and performs synchronous header/template setup; its method is no longer async. The flag marks entry, not completion or module readiness. View loaders await imports separately. No concrete reentrancy or bug cure was reproduced.

Scope: Account Hub widget initialization guards.
